lines.speaker: ryn
lines.text: All ships, stand down. Her home fleet has laid down its arms, General. It's over.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: They won't let me fly yet, but they let me sit at the table. I wouldn't miss this, General.

lines.speaker: ryn
lines.text: Every free world sent a delegate. No sovereign and no throne this time. A council, where every world has a voice.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: Whatever you told Isolde at the end, she was never going to kneel. That choice was always hers.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: There's a seat on the council for you, General. Not as anyone's weapon. As one voice among many.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Then I'll take it. No more thrones.
